INSERT INTO vm_statistics_checkpoint_event_hour (province_code, city_code, county_code, device_code, device_name, warning_hour, warning_num, year, month, day, create_date, tenant_id, warning_source, industry_code, app_ver_code) VALUES
(#{item.provinceCode},#{item.cityCode},#{item.countyCode},#{item.deviceCode},#{item.deviceName}, #{item.warningHour},#{item.warningNum},#{item.year},#{item.month},#{item.day},#{item.alarmTime},#{item.tenantId} ,#{item.warningSource},#{item.industryCode},#{item.appVerCode})
mapper.select: SELECT m.province_code, m.city_code, m.county_code, m.device_code, m.device_name, HOUR (m.alarm_time) as warning_hour, COUNT(1) as warning_num, YEAR (m.alarm_time) as year, MONTH (m.alarm_time) as month, DAY (m.alarm_time) as day, m.tenant_id, m.industry_code, m.app_ver_code,m.warning_source,m.alarm_time FROM ( SELECT a.province_code, a.city_code, a.county_code, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.alarm_time, a.tenant_id, a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, a.warning_source FROM vm_checkpoint_warning_order_t a WHERE DATE_FORMAT(a.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{handleDate}) m GROUP BY m.province_code, m.city_code, m.county_code, m.device_code, m.tenant_id, HOUR ( m.alarm_time ) ,m.warning_source, m.industry_code, m.app_ver_code
